_about: Trial glossary for es-419, de and ja, with ru added by the design step (proof only; Nathanial owns final wording). 'required' is the exact form a translation must contain whenever the English line contains the term; 'variants' lists inflected forms the checker also accepts. 'keep' terms are copied through untranslated. The checker, scripts/i18n/i18n_tool.py (check), reads this file; nothing else lists the terms. Moved here unchanged from the research branch codex/localization-research at 520cad1 (docs/research-2026-10/localization/pipeline/glossary.json) in PR L2, so the gate has a glossary; PR L5 grows it to the 10 languages with decisions D9 and D11 and adds the style guides beside it. For ru the 'required' form is a stem that every case form of the noun contains (Russian nouns change their ending by case: страж, стража, стражу), plus the capitalised variants; a station plate is quoted in «» in its own nominative form, so its plate words never change. 'keep' also lists the Latin-letter words that stay as written in every script: the 'E:' key token, the studio name and the person's name (the script guard skips them).
